t: Chip O'Theseus: The Evolving AI in a Bottle
s: The article introduces 'Chip O'Theseus', an evolving local LLM metaphorically named after the Ship of Theseus paradox, representing a continuously updated AI system built on a foundation of evolving web frameworks and training data.
sub: Chip O'Theseus: An evolving local LLM concept
Ship of Theseus paradox applied to AI identity and evolution
Evolution of Python web frameworks (itty.py, bottle.py, Flask, FastHTML)
AI training data challenges and future web crawls
